title: MF 135 · Perkins AD3.152 - Workshop Manual p.87

COOLING SYSTEM-N.5

Thermostat
A thermostat is installed in the cylinder head water
outlet to enable the engine to reach its correct tem­
perature faster.

The thermostat can be removed after the water
outlet connection has been removed (see fig. N7).

When a thermostat is fitted, ensure that the jiggle
pin in the top is free to move and the vent hole is
free from restriction.

FUEL SYSTEM-P.3

To renew fuel filter element (earlier
engines)
The earlier type main fuel filter contains a separate
paper element in a bowl fastened by a bolt at the
bottom of the bowl. A vent plug is fitted in the filter
head.

Renew the element as follows:
1.   Remove the bolt at the bottom of the filter
